documents.title: Wastewater treatment
documents.content: Municipal wastewater treatment removes contaminants from used water before it is discharged into rivers or reused. Treatment plants use screening, sedimentation, biological processes, and disinfection to reduce suspended solids, organic matter, and harmful microorganisms.

documents.title: Rainwater harvesting
documents.content: Rainwater harvesting captures runoff from roofs and other surfaces and stores it in tanks or cisterns. Filters and first-flush diverters improve water quality, while suitable storage and drainage systems help households conserve water during dry periods.

documents.title: Composting organic waste
documents.content: Composting converts food scraps, leaves, and other organic waste into a soil amendment through microbial decomposition. A balanced mixture of carbon-rich dry material, nitrogen-rich green material, moisture, and oxygen helps produce stable compost for gardens.

documents.title: Bird migration
documents.content: Bird migration is the seasonal movement of birds between breeding and nonbreeding habitats. Changes in daylight, temperature, food availability, and breeding conditions influence migration timing, while many species use inherited navigation cues and environmental landmarks.

documents.title: Growing basil
documents.content: Basil is a culinary herb that grows well in warm conditions with several hours of sunlight and well-drained soil. Container-grown basil needs regular watering without waterlogged roots, occasional pruning, and enough space for healthy leaves and branching stems.

documents.title: Password managers
documents.content: Password managers store login credentials in an encrypted vault protected by a master password or another authentication method. They can generate unique, strong passwords for websites, reduce password reuse, and help users fill credentials without memorizing every login.

documents.title: Home router security
documents.content: A home Wi-Fi router should use modern wireless encryption, a unique administrator password, and updated firmware. Disabling insecure management services, reviewing connected devices, and replacing default credentials can reduce unauthorized access to the local network.

documents.title: Solar photovoltaic panels
documents.content: Solar photovoltaic panels convert incoming sunlight into electrical energy using semiconductor cells. A rooftop system's output depends on panel capacity, orientation, shading, weather, temperature, and inverter efficiency. Household systems may store excess energy in batteries or export it to the grid.

documents.title: Yeast bread baking
documents.content: Commercial baker's yeast ferments sugars in bread dough and releases carbon dioxide, which forms gas bubbles and makes the dough rise. Kneading develops gluten, while proofing time, dough temperature, hydration, and oven heat influence bread texture and volume.

documents.title: Sourdough starter
documents.content: A sourdough starter is a culture of wild yeasts and lactic acid bacteria maintained with flour and water. Regular feeding supplies fresh nutrients, while temperature and hydration affect fermentation activity. A healthy starter produces gas and acidic compounds used to leaven and flavor bread.

documents.title: Marine insurance
documents.content: Marine insurance can protect shipowners, cargo owners, and transport businesses against specified losses during sea transport. Hull coverage concerns vessels, cargo insurance concerns goods in transit, and marine liability coverage addresses certain legal liabilities subject to policy terms and exclusions.

documents.title: Mortgage underwriting
documents.content: Mortgage underwriting evaluates whether a home loan applicant can repay a proposed loan. Lenders commonly examine income, employment history, existing debts, credit history, down payment, property valuation, and the relationship between monthly debt obligations and income.

documents.title: Volcanic ash hazards
documents.content: Volcanic ash consists of fine fragments of rock, minerals, and volcanic glass produced during eruptions. Ash clouds can reduce visibility, contaminate water supplies, damage machinery, disrupt aviation, and cause respiratory irritation. Protective equipment and timely hazard warnings reduce exposure.

documents.title: Plate tectonics
documents.content: Plate tectonics describes the movement and interaction of Earth's large lithospheric plates. Plates converge, separate, or slide past one another, contributing to earthquakes, volcanic activity, mountain building, ocean trenches, and the gradual movement of continents.

documents.title: Employment law
documents.content: Employment law governs aspects of the relationship between employers and workers. Depending on the jurisdiction, it can regulate wages, working hours, discrimination, workplace safety, leave, disciplinary procedures, termination, and remedies available when employment rights are violated.

documents.title: TLS keys and certificates
documents.content: Transport Layer Security uses cryptographic certificates and private keys to authenticate servers and establish secure connections. Certificate renewal prevents expiration-related outages, while controlled key rotation replaces cryptographic keys and requires careful deployment, validation, and secure handling of private key material.
